name: Cathars
description: The cathars are Innistrad's specialized holy warriors, trained by humans and the Church of Avacyn to strike back at supernatural horrors.

timeline.summary: Some of Innistrad's humans refuse to be victims and become slayers and cathars, and a few take all of humanity as their responsibility as guardians.
timeline.quote: Some become cathars, holy warriors who train to destroy the fiends that prey upon humanity.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The champion emerges in a parish by taking personal responsibility for striking a blow for humanity, sanctioned only by the support of a desperate people.
timeline.quote: It is a position given sanction by the support of a desperate people in a time of need.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gruesome murders in Wittal leave body parts at chapels; inquisitor Thedis is killed; the Leeraug pack is identified.
timeline.quote: identified the culprits as the Leeraug werewolf pack

citation.text: "Nearheath", section "The Estwald Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Priests and cathars kill devils on sight, knowing they herald ruin.
timeline.quote: Priests and cathars have taken to killing them on sight whenever possible

citation.text: "Sympathy for the Devils". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A tall shadow enters the clearing, and cathars drop a heavy net on the creature.
timeline.quote: Odric shouted to the cathars in the treetops, who cast down the heavy net

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Vronos shoots a woman in a village and orders the villagers' corpses burned, saving the children.
timeline.quote: Vronos issued his orders: some to heap the corpses in the village square

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: That night wolf-like child werewolves ambush Vronos's camp and kill his troops; he realizes the village children were not innocent.
timeline.quote: There were no innocents.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Vronos becomes the Gray Fencer, first of the masked cathars, and accepts that the hunter cannot pity.
timeline.quote: Combatting evil meant hardening the heart. The hunter cannot pity.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
timeline.quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
timeline.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
timeline.quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds a mad angel bound in a clearing, surrounded by cathars.
timeline.quote: The angel was bound with rope, an arrow protruding from her gut, wings bloodied.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A branch snaps and the mad angel points out Arlinn the werewolf to the cathars.
timeline.quote: There in the trees! A monster!

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Distracted cathars step back, and the mad angel breaks her ropes and takes flight.
timeline.quote: In a display of mad strength, she spread her wings with enough force to cast off the ropes that bound her.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The mad angel hurls an arrow that kills the youngest cathar.
timeline.quote: she tore the arrow from her gut and hurled it down at the youngest of the cathars.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Rembert attacks Arlinn with a branch and orders the cathars to kill the monster.
timeline.quote: Rembert was wielding the branch as a weapon, against her.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf kills the cathars who try to stop her, one by one.
timeline.quote: One after another. They all fell at the werewolf's mercy.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Cornered at the gorge by Rembert and the cathars, Arlinn braces for blows.
timeline.quote: She was surrounded, backed against the edge of the gorge, cathars on all sides and Rembert before her

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The mad angel seizes Rembert and carries him into the air.
timeline.quote: The angel shrieked as it closed its bloody fingers around Rembert's arms and pulled him, gasping and wide-eyed, into the air.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Maeli, guarded by cathars, remembers fleeing his burning village as his mother ordered.
timeline.quote: He had run into the forest like his mother had told him, and he had not gone back to the village.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
timeline.quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A monster fused from a horse and rider attacks Thalia, numbing her face before her gryff and cathars kill it.
timeline.quote: But then she strayed too close to a shambling thing the size of a large horse, and it wheeled on her.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
timeline.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Cathars burst into an inn with reports of a white witch, and Teferi joins them as an excuse to leave.
timeline.quote: cathars from the local church came charging into the inn with reports of a white witch seen in the woods

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

citation.text: "Tangles" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn smashes a dire's knee with a mace and the cathars finish him, and the dire names her Tovolar's favorite.
timeline.quote: "You. Tovolar's favorite ."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Some cathars succumb to despair at Avacyn's unmaking while others carry on her work.
timeline.quote: Some cathars succumbed to despair at Avacyn's unmaking.

citation.text: Cathar's Call (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cathars patrol the ruins of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

citation.text: Odric's Outrider (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tovolar joins the fray and cathars fall.
timeline.quote: The cathars fell like leaves as Tovolar himself joined the fray.

citation.text: Moonrager's Slash (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Witch, werewolf and cathar defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
timeline.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.

citation.text: Defend the Celestus (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arlinn surveys the aftermath, which survivors call the Harvesttide Massacre, and resolves that the ritual must be completed.
timeline.quote: the word has already been formed: massacre .

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Anders coaches a cathar gryff rider.
timeline.quote: Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight.

citation.text: Gryff Rider (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Odric's ouster, Torens deserts the cathars with a holy mace.
timeline.quote: He took a holy mace with him as a souvenir.

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
timeline.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Humans fight back with torch-wielding mobs, trained cathars, and the power of the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: They train specialized holy warriors called cathars to strike back against the supernatural horrors.

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: The filigreed visage of Vronos was always first among the dread hunters.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

relations.note: The guards heed her orders naturally.
relations.quote: the gathered guards heed her orders as naturally as breathing

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

relations.note: The cathars are Avacyn's holy warriors.
relations.quote: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours.

citation.text: Cathars' Crusade (Innistrad Remastered, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Moiren hunted the Town with two dozen cathars.
relations.quote: Two dozen of us cathars joined up to hunt down Hanweir

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Sep 2026.
